id: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors (1987)

facts.text: Skip it before dream group. Hypnocil only.
facts.why: Hypnocil is the dream suppressant Dr Gordon prescribes. Dream group is where they dream on purpose, so skipping a drink before it for Hypnocil is backwards.
facts.fix: Skip it on Hypnocil nights. Dr Gordon's orders.

facts.text: Will and his Wizard Master cards
facts.why: Will says in group that in his dreams he is the Wizard Master, and in his dream he faces Freddy as the Wizard Master. No cards in the script.
facts.fix: Will, the Wizard Master in his dream

vibe.verdict: A hospital ration sheet suits Westin Hills, but it is the same lab template as other films and misses Freddy's lines and Kristen's coffee trick.
missing: Kristen eating instant coffee grounds with fizzy drink to stay awake (the ward)
'Welcome to prime time' (Freddy to Jennifer, through the TV)
Joey's scream shattering the mirrors (the dream, after Freddy's tongues)
'Seven, eight, better stay up late' (Kristen's rhyme)
The roast suckling pig in Kristen's dream house
ideas: Swap 'Westin Hills stay-awake iced coffee' for 'Kristen's coffee grounds and cola', after how she stays awake on the ward.
Swap 'Freddy's boiler room Salisbury steak' for 'Dream house roast suckling pig', from the pig in Kristen's dream.
Swap the 'Ration sheet. Eat with your own spoon.' line for Kristen's rhyme 'Seven, eight, better stay up late.'
Print 'Welcome to prime time' under the popcorn line for the TV room, in place of the Dick Cavett note.
